limitations: This correction has not been tied to a specific visible game artifact or level-unloading behavior.
GPU fixtures use production image operations and extracted refresh methods, with bounded source-buffer and page-ownership adapters.
Coverage includes linear RGBA8, BC1 and BC3, two/three mips, one/two layers, GPU writes, partial copies/resolves, clears and pending CPU updates.
OS page faults, detiling and multisample behavior are not newly certified. No gameplay performance gain is claimed.
The clean executable was not separately played; its rebuilt rasterizer has the exact tested rendering changes and both GPU fixtures passed against its production link.
